data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO defense and security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski, Adam Bartosiewicz, and Krzysztof Wysocki. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Defense & Security comp universe of 24 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. The Defense & Security sector contains 24 total peers, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints in each category—below the minimum threshold for reliable median-based valuation. A sector-wide median approach would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity in business model, scale, and technology maturity across the broader Defense & Security landscape.

Without triangulated multiples from stage-matched or tier-matched peers, this analysis cannot responsibly produce a point estimate or range. The key uncertainty is WB Group's specific positioning within the sector—its revenue scale, profitability profile, customer concentration, and technology differentiation relative to the identified peer set remain undefined from available data. A credible valuation would require either (1) additional financial metrics from WB Group, or (2) clarification of which comparable firms most closely align on stage, revenue, and business model, enabling subset analysis.
